content.test_md_blob:
# Switch alert expansion and keep only one alert open

> Prove that when the user opens a second alert, the previously expanded alert collapses so no more than one alert is expanded at any time.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a browser and land on the portfolio dashboard page that contains the Alerts panel.

## Step 2

In the Alerts panel, open the alert titled "Technology concentration above target" and verify its detail is expanded inline within the list.

## Step 3

In the Alerts panel, store "Technology concentration above target" as baseline_expanded_alert while it is the currently expanded alert.

## Step 4

In the Alerts panel, open the different alert titled "NVDA crossed 52-week high".

## Step 5

Assert the alert titled "Technology concentration above target" is collapsed, the alert titled "NVDA crossed 52-week high" is expanded inline, no more than one alert is expanded in the Alerts panel, and no modal dialog is presented for the alert list.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-101, ac-100, ac-102, ac-113

Confirm state-transition check: previously expanded alert collapsed while the newly opened alert is expanded (equals) — the stated promise: Opening a different alert collapses the previously expanded alert.
